definitions.explanation: An honorific expression used when offering food or drink to someone of higher social status or to a guest. It is the honorific form of {食|た}べる and {飲|の}む, and is commonly heard in restaurants, formal dining, and hospitality settings.

examples.japanese: ⟦どうぞ→どうぞ：02920_douzo⟧お{召|め}し{上|あ}がり⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
お⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できました→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。⟦{温|あたた}かい→温かい：13395_atatakai⟧うち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧お{召|め}し{上|あ}がり⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: The food is ready. Please eat it while it's warm.

examples.japanese: ⟦{店員|てんいん}→店員：00897_tenin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧「お⟦{飲|の}み{物|もの}→飲み物：02929_nomimono⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧お{召|め}し{上|あ}がり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なります→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{聞|き}いた→聞く：00483_kiku⟧。
examples.english: The server asked, "Would you like something to drink?"

examples.japanese: ⟦こちら→こちら：00960_kochira⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ケーキ→ケーキ：01356_keeki⟧、ぜひお{召|め}し{上|あ}がりになってみて⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。

notes:
The honorific noun form of ⟦{召|め}し{上|あ}がる→召し上がる：01310_meshiagaru⟧ (to eat, to drink), used mainly in set phrases addressed to guests or customers (offers, questions such as whether food will be eaten in the shop, serving instructions), and in お{召|め}し{上|あ}がり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ as an honorific verb.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- お{召|め}し{上|あ}がり⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧: please eat/drink, please help yourself (the standard offering)
- お{召|め}し{上|あ}がり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なります→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧: will you have some? (honorific question)
- ⟦{店内|てんない}→店内：03124_tennai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧お{召|め}し{上|あ}がりです⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧: will you be eating in? (at a counter)

USAGE:
Heard constantly in restaurants, shops, hotels and at formal meals. It covers both eating and drinking.

WATCH OUT:
⟦{召|め}し{上|あ}がる→召し上がる：01310_meshiagaru⟧ is already honorific, so お{召|め}し{上|あ}がり is strictly a double honorific. The phrases above are long established and accepted, but ⟦{召|め}し{上|あ}がって→召し上がる：01310_meshiagaru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧ is the textbook form, and stacking more (お{召|め}し{上|あ}がりになって⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧) sounds overdone to some ears.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{食|た}べて→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧ / ⟦{飲|の}んで→飲む：00322_nomu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧: polite but not honorific
- ⟦いただく→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧: humble form of eating/drinking, used about oneself, never when offering to others
